lines.text: Paul asks the church to receive him as a fool, since many are boasting according to the flesh.
Paul says he is a Hebrew, an Israelite, and a descendant of Moses, just like the boasters.
Paul received the forty lashes minus one five times, was beaten with rods three times, and was stoned once.
Paul was shipwrecked twice and spent a night and a day in the open sea.
In Damascus the governor under King Aretas wanted to arrest Paul, but Paul was lowered in a basket through a window.
